item.title: Griffon String Quartet Continues Year-Round Door County Engagement
item.description: Adam Collins -- The Griffon String Quartet continues to be a vibrant arts presence throughout Door County.

item.title: Door County YMCA to Host Annual Community Breakfast at Stone Harbor Resort
item.description: Adam Collins -- The Door County YMCA has announced plans for its annual Community Breakfast, set for Thursday, February 12, at Stone Harbor Resort in Sturgeon Bay.

item.title: Wisconsin Department of Revenue Highlights Identity Theft Awareness Week
item.description: Adam Collins -- The Wisconsin Department of Revenue is urging residents in Door and Kewaunee counties to take extra precautions against identity theft as tax season gets underway.

item.title: Outsourced Building Plan Review Considered in Sevastopol
item.description: Adam Collins -- Some contractors working in Door and Kewaunee counties are seeing faster turnaround times for commercial building projects as more municipalities adopt E-Plan Exam.

item.title: Better health begins with your feet
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- Before you lace up and head out the door, you might want to take another look at the shoes you're wearing.

item.title: Schoemann drops out of Wisconsin governor’s race
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- President Donald Trump's endorsement of U.S. Rep. Tom Tiffany for Wisconsin governor has ended Washington County Executive Josh Schoemann's bid for the state's top office.

item.title: Community prepared to honor Hecht’s life Thursday and Friday
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- Big crowds are expected Thursday and Friday in Ellison Bay, where visitation and funeral services will be held for former Sister Bay/Liberty Grove Fire Chief Chris Hecht.

item.title: Zellner becomes latest Kewaunee County sheriff candidate
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- The field to replace current Kewaunee County Sheriff Matt Joski has grown to three candidates.

item.title: Future Door County trails continue to take shape
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- Door County residents will have two upcoming opportunities to weigh in on how they travel throughout the peninsula.

item.title: Gamblers’ Teddy-Bear-Toss Game Combines Hockey, History, and Heart
item.description: Adam Collins -- Saturday's contest at the Resch Center marks the Gamblers' annual Teddy Bear Toss, a long-running tradition that turns a night of hockey into a community-wide act of generosity.
